statement: Just after 23:15 I went to get ice. A man came out of the library in a real hurry, carrying a green umbrella. He went down the stairs towards the second floor. When he passed me I could smell whisky.

A man came to the bar at about quarter past ten and ordered double whiskies. He charged them to his room, which was on the second floor. He kept asking what time the library closed, and he seemed nervous.
I was in my room all evening. I've never met any of the other guests. My uncle Victor and I got on very well.
I went to the library at about ten to return a book, then went straight to bed.
I swiped into the library at about twenty past eleven to find a book, but the lights were off and it was too dark to see anything, so I went back to my room.
I went to the library just before half eleven, but the door was stuck so I gave up and went back to my room.
I cleaned the library at about eleven, like every night. Victor was there, reading. He was fine when I left.
The storm knocked out the lift at about nine. Everyone had to use the stairs all night.
I was in the kitchen until midnight cleaning up. I didn't see anything.
The bar was busy all night. Lots of people were stuck because of the storm.
I heard raised voices somewhere downstairs at about eleven, but I thought it was the wind.
I was in the spa until it closed at nine, then I watched a film in my room.
